summary: Wrote the homily for the 1962 First Sunday of Advent (spoken body sections/homily/10-homily.tex, about 1,354 words, about 10.4-11.3 minutes by arithmetic; terminal note and References sections/homily/90-note.tex), declared [document.homily] in publication.toml and generated homily.tex with tools/tpt document-types refresh. It joins the first interpretation (Gregory: the lifted head as a gladdened heart because a world one does not love is ending; the Gradual's exspectant beside the Gospel's exspectatione) and the third (Paul's hour to rise with Chrysostom, Augustine's 'presently', the Collect's prayer that Christ come and set us free), with one response from the Offertory antiphon. It adds no source or locus beyond the accepted studies. It records the homily's own connections in the note and keeps clear of SYN-010 to SYN-012 and the settled corrections. Content, component, schema, web-edition, metadata and all homily preflight checks pass, provenance-matches-run included; a 4-page author proof built clean.
